entities.name: Flarg
entities.description: A cluster of mountains in the north of the Balduvian Steppe, in New Argive, historically home to goblins.

entities.name: Goblins of the Flarg
entities.description: Goblins who raided far south during the Dark Age.

entities.name: Tivadar of Thorn
entities.description: Rallied the Church of Tal for a crusade against goblins.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church rallied by Tivadar against goblins.

entities.name: Tivadar's Crusade
entities.description: Years-long campaign to exterminate goblins from civilized lands.

entities.name: Raiders
entities.description: Goblin faction that exterminated the Packers in a cricket game.

entities.name: Packers
entities.description: Goblin faction that exterminated the Raiders.

entities.name: Argivian University
entities.description: Sent representatives to excavate the ruins.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Flood that raised the Sea of Laments.

events.summary: The Flarg's goblins raid far south across the plains during the Dark Age.
events.quote: The Goblins of the Flarg were particularly active during the second era

events.summary: Tivadar of Thorn rallies the Church of Tal and, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, wages a crusade that decimates the goblin hordes.
events.quote: the goblin hordes had been decimated, retreating into their northern abodes

events.summary: A goblin cricket game escalates until the Raiders and Packers exterminate each other, ending the goblin threat.
events.quote: the Raiders and the Packers exterminated each other
